info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Business Hours API

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

items.docs: Returns the company business hours schedule. Business hours (and After hours - all the remaining time) schedules are commonly used for setting call handling rules - `business-hours-rule` and `after-hours-rule` correspondingly.

params.name: accountId

Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

items.docs: Updates the company business hours schedule.

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

params.name: extensionId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral extension/user
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the extension associated with current authorization session should be used)

items.docs: Returns the user business hours schedule. Business hours (and After hours - all the remaining time) schedules are commonly used for setting call handling rules - `business-hours-rule` and `after-hours-rule` correspondingly. **Please note:** If the user business hours are set to 'Custom hours' then a particular schedule is returned; however if set to '24 hours/7 days a week' the schedule will be empty.
